name: progress-bar
description: A progress bar above the prompt for long work: Claude fills one in through a tool, and any shell script or command reports its own through a unix socket (pbar), with a warning when a job stalls or dies. See how far along things are without asking.

auto_report.title: Ask Claude to report progress
auto_report.description: Add a short instruction to Claude's system prompt telling it to call the progress tool on longer tasks. Turn off to only have the tool available.

show_eta.title: Show time left
show_eta.description: Estimate the time left from how fast the reported percentage has moved. Shown as ~12m once there is enough to go on.

bar_width.title: Bar width
bar_width.description: Cells in the bar. It shrinks on a narrow terminal.

watch_jobs.title: Watch background jobs
watch_jobs.description: Start a small hub on a unix socket so scripts and `pbar` can report jobs that show as bars under Claude's. Needs python3.

stall_after.title: Call a job stalled after (seconds)
stall_after.description: Silence that turns a job's row yellow. A job that is slow by nature is given more time automatically.

notify.title: Notify when a job ends or stalls
notify.description: A toast, and a native notification where the terminal has one, so you hear about it when you are away.

wake_claude.title: Wake Claude when a job ends
wake_claude.description: off: never. on-failure: when a job fails, dies or stalls. always: also when it finishes. A woken Claude starts a turn of its own.
